description: This file defines jQuery plugin methods for calculating element dimensions, scroll positions, and offsets, specifically for jQuery version 1.2+.

methods.name: innerHeight
methods.description: Calculates the inner height of an element, including padding.

methods.name: innerWidth
methods.description: Calculates the inner width of an element, including padding.

methods.name: outerHeight
methods.description: Calculates the outer height of an element, including border and optionally margin.

methods.name: outerWidth
methods.description: Calculates the outer width of an element, including border and optionally margin.

methods.name: scrollLeft
methods.description: Gets or sets the horizontal scroll position of an element or window.

methods.name: scrollTop
methods.description: Gets or sets the vertical scroll position of an element or window.

methods.name: position
methods.description: Calculates the position of an element relative to its offset parent.

methods.name: offsetParent
methods.description: Returns the closest offset parent of the element.
